_comment: Update pointer for the 'Update Library' flow. A device fetches this file, compares latest.libraryVersion to its installed catalog, and (if newer) downloads latest.url (the catalog manifest), then fetches each board listed in manifest.boards in order, validates them, and loads them via loadLibrary(boards, { libraryVersion }).

latest.notes: Minor: parse what the firmware accepts. The composer now recognizes stored commands it showed as unrecognized raw steps. Engine: an empty fragment (a stray, doubled or trailing ^) becomes no step, since the WCB skips empty segments too. Two new param flags: omittable (the firmware accepts the command with the param left off and uses its own default; the composer offers a Board default choice) and leadingZeros (the firmware reads the number with atoi/toInt, so 03 is 3). FlthyHPs Holoprojectors (flthy-hps): the colour is omittable on Color Projector, Dim Pulse, Cycle, Solid Color and Short Circuit, and the speed on Dim Pulse, so A007 decodes as Short Circuit in the board's own colour and A0031 as Dim Pulse at the board's speed. RC Control L/R and U/D and Wag L/R and U/D accept a |n duration (FlthyHPs v1.81 stops them after n seconds). PSIPro (psi-pro) Run Effect and IA MagicPanel (ia-magic-panel) Run Mode accept leading zeros (4T03, T00). Saved values still decode losslessly; rebuilding a value writes the canonical form (4T3, no empty segments), which the firmware runs identically. No ids, templates or params change; board and command counts are unchanged.
